- POC objective: real-time agent assist (streaming suggestions) + ticket summarization post-call + safe tool-calling into their Case Tracking System (CTS).
- Customer emphasis: low-latency SLOs (95p token latency target 200ms), predictable cost under spikes (burst capacity pricing), and strict data residency for EU customers.
- Quote from CTO: "If we can't guarantee sub-250ms for inline suggestions during peak, agents will disable the feature." Need strong fallback behavior.
- Technical ask: demo of continuous batching + KV cache warmup patterns; show how Redwood handles prefix-heavy contexts without blowing up latency.
- Guardrails: want built-in hallucination mitigation for tool-calls (strict schema + action validation), redaction/PII masking for transcripts, and configurable confidence thresholds for auto-fill suggestions.
- POC acceptance criteria (agreed):
  * 95p suggestion latency <= 200ms under 800 concurrent agent sessions
  * tool-call roundtrip <= 350ms when invoking CTS write APIs
  * no data leaves VPC for EU-resident tenants; KMS encryption keys for audit logs
  * basic quality gate: F1 > 0.85 on intent extraction for 10k historical tickets
- Integration notes: will route suggestions through their middleware (Kafka topics) and call Redwood via private endpoints. Dev team prefers TLS mutual auth + SAML SSO for admin UI.
- Pricing: interested in reserved Dedicated pool for baseline, plus burst reserve for seasonal spikes (Q4). Asking for 12-month commit vs monthly burst add-on options.
- Competitive tension: evaluating GoliathAI for lower price; Supportly pitched serverless approach but failed latency tests in house.
